title: Metabolic Pathways and Yeast Research
summary: This cluster revolves around the metabolic pathways of yeast, specifically S. cerevisiae LMD17, and their interactions with various chemicals and processes. Cysteine and methionine are catabolized by the Ehrlich pathway, while pantothenic acid is involved in fermentation and is biosynthesized from Coenzyme A. The research on yeast, conducted by FEMS Yeast Research, is authored by Audrey Bloem and Duncan James D. The cluster also includes various chemicals, such as acetic acid, succinic acid, and nitrogen, which are involved in different processes like transcriptome analysis and CO2 production rate.
